description: On a green tabletop, there’s a white AirPods charging case next to a white charging cable, with plain boards propped up in the background. The left hand reaches in from the left to grasp the cable plug and guide it toward the case while the right hand comes in from the right to pick up and steady the case; then the left hand inserts the plug into the case so the cable becomes the left-hand object and the case remains the right-hand object before both hands ease off.
